slide1.subtitle: A new era in AI coding

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: SpaceX acquired AI coding startup Cursor for $60 billion.
This deal doubles the net worth of Cursor's 20-something cofounders.
The acquisition is a significant move in the AI coding space.
It marks a major investment in AI technology.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The acquisition gives SpaceX a significant edge in AI coding.
It allows the company to expand its capabilities in AI-powered technologies.
The deal is a testament to the growing importance of AI in the tech industry.
It highlights the need for companies to invest in AI research and development.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The acquisition is a strategic move by SpaceX to strengthen its position in the AI market.
It demonstrates the company's commitment to innovation and technological advancements.
The deal is expected to have a significant impact on the AI coding landscape.
